items.t: Oceania Cruises® Unveils New Chef's Studio Aboard Oceania Marina™
items.sum: Oceania Cruises® has unveiled a new Chef's Studio aboard Oceania Marina™, introducing an intimate venue for culinary education, destination discovery and chef-hosted experiences at sea.
